<h1>Step Velocity</h1>

## Purpose

Edit the per-step **velocity** of the selected sequencer. Each of the 16
steps stores one of 8 row-selected velocity levels, with row 1 as the
lowest setting and row 8 as the highest.

## Interaction

Columns are steps (LHS = 1–8, RHS = 9–16), rows are values (row 1 bottom =
lowest velocity … row 8 top = highest). Each step lights a **single pad** at
the height of its stored value, not a bar filled from the bottom; a
positioner colour marks the playing step, and columns whose step carries a
trig are shaded slate behind the contour. Pressing a pad writes that row's
velocity to that step instantly. No modifier needed.

## Shortcuts

| Gesture | Where | Action | Modifiers |
|---|---|---|---|
| Press | LP grid | Set the step (column) to the pressed row's velocity | none |
| SHIFT + MUTE + press row R | LP grid | **Reset**: all 16 steps → velocity of row R | shift+mute |
| SHIFT + MUTE + press | LP LHS col 9 | **Reset**: all 16 steps → `5` (row 6, the velocity identity ×1.0) | shift+mute |
| SHIFT + SOLO + press row R | LP grid | **Randomise**: all 16 steps gaussian around row R (clamped to rows 1–8) | shift+solo |
| SHIFT + SOLO + press | LP LHS col 9 | **Randomise**: all 16 steps uniform random across values 0–7 | shift+solo |
| Row-mode gestures | Row mutes | Row play-mode controls still apply (see "Row mode" in [Trig view reference](/documentation/MSEQ/views/trig)) | any |
